scope.summary: After an intentional killed-session case the W4 driver restarts the MCP client at the lane's READ_ONLY baseline instead of sending a level drop to the dead session, so the full unscoped FREE23 lane no longer aborts with 'failed to drop before profile switch'.
out_of_scope: Missing rel012 release-manifest scenarios (oraclemcp-bb5qm) and other red W4 cases.

entry_points.name: bash scripts/e2e/w4.sh --lane free23 (full unscoped external-client lane)
entry_points.trace: 725 case rows executed over stdio and HTTP through and after both killed-session cases; zero occurrences of 'failed to drop before profile switch'; the run reached the final release-manifest gate.

limitations: The full FREE23 lane is still red: 19 rel012 manifest scenarios missing/red (oraclemcp-bb5qm); w4_runtime_issue46_scn_probe_cached red because the positive-diff flashback grant covers the whole stdio pass (ww2n3); 23 re-read cases per transport red because w4_runtime_issue49_commit_race_not_reported_cancelled leaves T_PARENT ID=2 labelled 'w4-commit-race' (.7.5). This bead claims only removal of the profile-switch abort.
Only the free23 full lane was re-run at d3c68ae7 (xe21/xe18 full lanes not re-run).
